name: image availability
pass: image starts without pull from untrusted registry

name: persistent data
check: database, uploads, vault and library paths mapped

name: secret parity
check: production secrets injected without plaintext logs
pass: OAuth and storage config present, secrets redacted

name: egress
pass: all stages pass within bounded timeout

name: oauth callback
check: Google redirect URI and callback host match
pass: callback reaches 2c API and request_id is logged

name: cutover
check: DNS or reverse-proxy switch with TTL and drain window

name: rollback
pass: rollback completes within 5 minutes and old path healthy
